==Purpose of template==
Render alternative text on [[Aine]] 17 and adds the page to [[:Category:April Fools pages]].

==How to use==
<code><nowiki>{{April1 |joke=</nowiki>''joke_text''<nowiki> |real=</nowiki>''serious_text''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

<pre>
{{April1
 | joke = 
 | real =
}}
</pre>

<pre>{{April1 |joke=It's [[Aine]] 17! |real=April 1st is the 17th of [[Aine]].}}</pre>
